build.description: Primary coding agent for development work

planner.description: Expert planning specialist for complex features and refactoring. Use for implementation planning, architectural changes, or complex refactoring.

architect.description: Software architecture specialist for system design, scalability, and technical decision-making.

code-reviewer.description: Expert code review specialist. Reviews code for quality, security, and maintainability. Use immediately after writing or modifying code.

security-reviewer.description: Security vulnerability detection and remediation specialist. Use after writing code that handles user input, authentication, API endpoints, or sensitive data.

tdd-guide.description: Test-Driven Development specialist enforcing write-tests-first methodology. Use when writing new features, fixing bugs, or refactoring code. Ensures 80%+ test coverage.

build-error-resolver.description: Build and TypeScript error resolution specialist. Use when build fails or type errors occur. Fixes build/type errors only with minimal diffs.

e2e-runner.description: End-to-end testing specialist using Playwright. Generates, maintains, and runs E2E tests for critical user flows.

doc-updater.description: Documentation and codemap specialist. Use for updating codemaps and documentation.

refactor-cleaner.description: Dead code cleanup and consolidation specialist. Use for removing unused code, duplicates, and refactoring.

go-reviewer.description: Expert Go code reviewer specializing in idiomatic Go, concurrency patterns, error handling, and performance.

go-build-resolver.description: Go build, vet, and compilation error resolution specialist. Fixes Go build errors with minimal changes.

database-reviewer.description: Multi-engine database specialist for query optimization, schema design, security, and performance across PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, ClickHouse, MongoDB, DynamoDB, and Redis. Incorporates Supabase best practices.

cpp-reviewer.description: Expert C++ code reviewer specializing in memory safety, modern C++ idioms, concurrency, and performance. Use for all C++ code changes.

cpp-build-resolver.description: C++ build, CMake, and compilation error resolution specialist. Fixes build errors, linker issues, and template errors with minimal changes.

docs-lookup.description: Specialized documentation, package research, and open-source implementation specialist. Researches libraries, evaluates version trade-offs, fetches official API syntax via Context7, and finds real-world open-source examples with GitHub permalinks.

harness-optimizer.description: Analyze and improve the local agent harness configuration for reliability, cost, and throughput.

java-reviewer.description: Expert Java and Spring Boot code reviewer specializing in layered architecture, JPA patterns, security, and concurrency.

java-build-resolver.description: Java/Maven/Gradle build, compilation, and dependency error resolution specialist. Fixes build errors with minimal changes.

kotlin-reviewer.description: Kotlin and Android/KMP code reviewer. Reviews Kotlin code for idiomatic patterns, coroutine safety, Compose best practices.

kotlin-build-resolver.description: Kotlin/Gradle build, compilation, and dependency error resolution specialist. Fixes Kotlin build errors with minimal changes.

loop-operator.description: Operate autonomous agent loops, monitor progress, and intervene safely when loops stall.

php-reviewer.description: Expert PHP code reviewer specializing in PSR-12 compliance, PHP type system, Eloquent ORM patterns, security, and performance.

python-reviewer.description: Expert Python code reviewer specializing in PEP 8 compliance, Pythonic idioms, type hints, security, and performance.

ruby-reviewer.description: Expert Ruby and Rails code reviewer specializing in idiomatic Ruby, Active Record query safety, Rails security defaults, and RSpec/Minitest quality.

rust-reviewer.description: Expert Rust code reviewer specializing in idiomatic Rust, ownership, lifetimes, concurrency, and performance.

rust-build-resolver.description: Rust build, Cargo, and compilation error resolution specialist. Fixes Rust build errors with minimal changes.

intent-gate.description: First-stage intent classifier. Analyzes one user message and returns a structured verdict (intent restate, type, clarity, owner-decision forks, adopted assumptions). Runs before the build agent executes substantive work so the user's prompt is confirmed before work starts.

multimodal-looker.description: Visual and media asset specialist. Analyzes UI screenshots, design mockups, diagrams, and PDFs to extract layout hierarchies, color tokens, typography scales, and component states.

plan-reviewer.description: Practical implementation plan reviewer (Momus). Verifies that plans are executable, referenced files exist on disk, and catches blocking issues.

comment-analyzer.description: Analyze code comments for accuracy, completeness, maintainability, and comment rot risk.

pr-test-analyzer.description: Review pull request test coverage quality and completeness, with emphasis on behavioral coverage and real bug prevention.

silent-failure-hunter.description: Review code for silent failures, swallowed errors, bad fallbacks, and missing error propagation.

type-design-analyzer.description: Analyze type design for encapsulation, invariant expression, usefulness, and enforcement.

code-simplifier.description: Simplifies and refines code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving behavior.

security-hunter.description: Adversarial vulnerability hunter for the /security-audit 6-phase harness. Reads source and executes PoCs only inside the Lima sandbox. Returns structured candidate results per assigned coverage unit.

security-verifier.description: Independent adversarial verifier for /security-audit. Tries to DISPROVE candidates produced by other hunters. Never the same agent instance that produced the candidate. Also runs coverage-critic passes.

explore.description: Fast agent specialized for exploring codebases. Returns actionable results with absolute paths.

rules-map.description: Inventory existing project rules and report duplicates, conflicts, and gaps without changing anything

rules-add.description: Add or revise a project rule with owner approval

design-build.description: Build a frontend section by section with an interactive canvas review loop: material, taste deal, frozen contract, per-section approve, purpose-driven assets, scaffold, and anti-slop gate

typography.description: Design, systematize, and polish typography across brand selection (ux-typography), token scaling (typography-system), and craft rendering (better-typography)

tdd.description: Enforce TDD workflow with 80%+ test coverage

orchestrate.description: Orchestrate multiple agents for complex tasks

learn.description: Extract patterns and learnings from session

code-review-quick.description: Fast, focused code review with git marker tracking and scope negotiation
